scenarios.title: Authorized execution
scenarios.description: A valid full-scope grant authorizes every bounded step and permits simulated governed execution.

scenarios.title: Missing approval
scenarios.description: Approval-required work without an effective grant pauses before execution.

scenarios.title: Explicit authority denial
scenarios.description: An overlapping explicit denial overrides an otherwise valid grant and blocks execution.

scenarios.title: Authority scope mismatch
scenarios.description: A grant lacking required step scope pauses before execution.
